draft.shortGloss: to see; to watch; to look

notes: देखना (dekhnā) covers the entire range of visual perception—from a simple glance to focused viewing like watching a film or a match.
Do not confuse it with दिखाना (dikhānā), which means 'to show'.

senses.definition: To turn your eyes towards something or direct your gaze at an object.

examples.translation: He looked out of the window.
examples.emotion: curious and quiet, glancing outside to see the weather

senses.definition: To notice or perceive something with your eyes.

examples.text: मैंने कल बाजार में एक पुराना दोस्त देखा।
examples.translation: I saw an old friend in the market yesterday.
examples.emotion: surprised and pleased to spot someone familiar unexpectedly

senses.definition: To look at something for an extended period of time, such as a film or a sports match.

examples.text: हम रात को एक अच्छी फिल्म देखेंगे।
examples.translation: We will watch a good film tonight.
examples.emotion: excited and relaxed, looking forward to evening entertainment
